_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. Re-read live at 10:22 ET from the broker and unchanged from the 09:42 open read: 128.90 total, all of it cash, nothing unsettled, so deployable is the full balance. No equity or option positions are open, which is why the mid-session run had no exit to enforce.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the 8/5 open
entryWatch.why: Resolved against, and the first hour made it more so rather than less. AMD is bid 486.55 at 10:22 ET against a 518.58 official close, about -6.2%, which is lower than the 491.73 the open read showed. A continuation setup needs a strong reaction to continue and the reaction is negative and still deteriorating, so this is the gap-down branch, which the rulebook answers with stand aside. Bouncing off the low would not have reclaimed the close; it has not even bounced.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong but the leader is already extended
entryWatch.why: Conditional on a strong leader, and the leader printed red. There is no upside chain to find a laggard in. SMCI, the name this read pointed at, is bid 31.01 and down about 2.1% - it is not lagging a move, it is following the same one down, and it has widened its loss since the open.

entryWatch.trigger: A pullback that holds on 8/6 or 8/7, not today's reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Still the one live catalyst on the list, and still the one entry the rulebook explicitly forbids today. UPST reported 8/4 after the bell and is bid 32.36 at 10:22 ET against a 30.32 close, about +6.7%. That is the reaction day itself, which checklist item 2 calls a wait signal. The first hour has firmed it slightly off the 32.23 open bid rather than resolving anything: a reaction day that holds is still a reaction day. The setup that fits is the day-2/3 pullback, which by definition cannot be bought today, and a mid-session run is the last place that should decide otherwise.

entryWatch.trigger: Leader gapped down, most of the list red, only catalyst is a reaction-day spike
entryWatch.why: The branch the open resolved to and the position the account is still in an hour later. Seven of the nine candidates are red at 10:22, the eighth is a print-day spike the checklist forbids chasing, and four of the nine report tonight. Nothing in the first hour changed a flag or opened a setup. A one-position account has no way to be wrong cheaply here, and deployable cash keeps for a setup that fits.
